GATE-07.Purpose: Converge shared UI/security with employee-facing/domain capabilities before browser/UAT acceptance.
GATE-07.Required External Dependencies: EXT-0014; EXT-0016; EXT-0019 where affected capability activation applies
GATE-07.Evidence Required: Backend authorization tests; UI state tests; Persian/RTL/Jalali checks; request/status/deep-link evidence; sensitive-data controls.
GATE-07.Pass Condition: User-facing target capabilities are functionally integrated without widening source-domain authority.
GATE-07.Failure Consequence: Browser verification and affected representative UAT scenarios remain blocked.
GATE-07.Notes: Capability-by-capability emergence is allowed; this gate summarizes convergence.

GATE-08.Purpose: Record environment-specific verification only after implementation availability.
GATE-08.Required External Dependencies: EXT-0020; EXT-0021; EXT-0022; EXT-0023; EXT-0024 as applicable
GATE-08.Evidence Required: Executed runtime scenarios, environment/build identity, logs/results, explicit PASS/FAIL per verification item.
GATE-08.Pass Condition: Required verification items have executed evidence; no static evidence is promoted to runtime PASS.
GATE-08.Failure Consequence: Affected production/UAT/certification decisions remain blocked or UTV.
GATE-08.Downstream Work Unlocked: UAT convergence and Production Certification evidence
GATE-08.Notes: Not every feature requires every verification item.

GATE-11.Purpose: Certify production/system-operational readiness only after GATE-10 Representative UAT Completion and all existing production readiness controls/evidence are satisfied.
GATE-11.Evidence Required: Activated official statutory package where applicable; backup/restore evidence; deployment drill; observability/incident drill; supply-chain re-verification; approved topology/recovery/operating evidence.
GATE-11.Pass Condition: GATE-10 Representative UAT Completion has PASSED; all required Production Certification IMB items are complete; required runtime/production evidence is available; required external production evidence is available; and no unresolved production-certification blocker remains.
GATE-11.Failure Consequence: Production certification remains NOT COMPLETE regardless of feature/UAT state.
GATE-11.Downstream Work Unlocked: Future production release decision and Human Sign-off review
GATE-11.Notes: GATE-10 → GATE-11 is mandatory. PRODUCTION CERTIFICATION ≠ HUMAN SIGN-OFF. GATE-11 is not currently passed.
